title: Logarithmic Tracing and Equilibrium Selection in Asymmetric Coordination Games
abstract: arXiv:2611.28515v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study equilibrium selection in asymmetric pure coordination games with finitely many players and actions. A logarithmic regularization defines a tracing-type path of interior equilibria from the uniform strategy profile. We reduce the equilibrium conditions to single-peaked scalar functions and show that, when one associated payoff index is uniquely minimal, the connected equilibrium branch from the uniform profile converges to the corresponding coordinated outcome. With two players, this condition is equivalent to maximizing the sum of square-root payoffs, extending the known two-action result to finitely many actions. A three-player example shows that the square-root rule does not generally extend to more players.

translated_title: 非对称协调博弈中的对数追踪与均衡选择
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有有限参与人和有限行动的非对称纯协调博弈中的均衡选择问题。一种对数正则化方法定义了从均匀策略组合出发的内部均衡的追踪型路径。我们将均衡条件约化为单峰标量函数，并证明当某个相关的收益指标唯一最小时，从均匀策略组合出发的连通均衡分支收敛到相应的协调结果。在两人博弈的情形下，该条件等价于最大化平方根收益之和，从而将已知的两行动结果推广到有限多行动的情形。一个三人博弈的例子表明，平方根法则一般无法推广到更多参与人的情形。
tldr: 该论文通过对数正则化构造追踪型均衡路径，证明了当相关收益指标唯一最小时均衡分支收敛到协调结果，并在两人博弈中将平方根收益最大化法则从两行动情形推广到有限多行动情形，同时揭示该法则不能推广至三人及以上的博弈。
en_tdlr: This paper uses logarithmic regularization to construct a tracing-type path of equilibria, proving that the equilibrium branch converges to the coordinated outcome when a payoff index is uniquely minimal, extending the square-root payoff maximization rule from two-action to finitely many-action two-player games while showing it generally fails for three or more players.
